notes.title: HD Rendering Update
notes.notes: Updated with a new rendering post processor. Now with sharper HD image on surfaces with less GPU call times. Improved frames per second and overall image quality.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3.9
notes.notes: Had a rotate issue with Index Knuckles Controllers. moved the rotate function away from the grip sensors. Rotate is now on the joysticks only for the Index Knuckles Controllers.
